# Dan Buchholz's Personal Website

> A personal website and blog for Dan Buchholz, built with Next.js, featuring an interactive terminal interface and technical writing about blockchain systems, distributed systems, and software engineering.

The site consists of a main landing page with an interactive terminal, blog posts, and an about page detailing professional experience. The terminal supports various commands including AI-powered content analysis.

## Core Pages

- [About Page](https://danbuchholz.com/about): Professional background and experience
- [Blog Index](https://danbuchholz.com/blog): Collection of technical writing and posts
- [Terminal Guide](https://danbuchholz.com/api/llms/terminal.md): Documentation for the interactive terminal interface and available commands
